lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 to 12 distinct white vertical lines traversing the torso; spacing is wider on the anterior flank (approx. 5-7% of torso width) and becomes more compressed toward the posterior flank (approx. 3-4% of torso width).
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 6th vertical stripe (counting from shoulder) where the line splits into a 'Y' shape toward the dorsal ridge; a second merging point is visible on the 10th stripe near the upper haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 2nd and 8th vertical stripes terminate mid-flank without reaching the ventral boundary; the 4th stripe is interrupted by a gap near the mid-torso horizontal axis.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 8 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch and upper hind limb; density is highest in the central region of the thigh.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the posterior haunch align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line approximately 15% of the distance from the tail base to the hock.

other_distinctive_markers: White circular spot located on the lower mandible/cheek; distinct white crest of hair running along the dorsal spine; dark transition in pixel intensity (dark socks) on the lower distal limbs starting above the fetlock.
